## Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you'd like to see.

## Problem it solves
Explain the problem or use case this feature would address.

## Proposed solution
Describe your proposed solution or implementation approach.

## Alternatives considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context
Add any other context or examples here.

## Would you be willing to contribute this feature?
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to work on this
- [ ] I'd help review PRs for this
- [ ] No, I just have the suggestion
